about.p1:
Senior Art Director & Photographer. Based in Bogotá, Colombia. I approach projects with a global vision, talking with the client to understand their brand and its DNA, focusing on what is the best way to implement an idea for the project, and how to translate it across various media: from web architecture and user experience design, to photography, illustration, and comprehensive branding.
This portfolio itself was built using vibe coding, combining AI-assisted development with my UX/UI expertise — and is fully optimized for both traditional search engines and AI-powered search.
about.p2:
As a UX/UI designer, my goal is to transform a brand's vision into engaging digital and tangible experiences that are clear and authentic. I currently work as an independent freelance professional, helping my clients to tell their stories through design.

I'm now embracing vibe coding, using AI with my creative Art Direction skills to take them to the next level and build exceptional projects like this portfolio.
about.p3:
My work is an extension of my lifestyle: I am constantly learning about technology, tendencies, techniques. Always looking for references. I look for aesthetics everywhere, whether in the forms of nature, architecture, urban colors, pop culture or everyday details.

I strongly believe that constant learning is the best way to create good design.
about.p4:
My process begins with listening. It's not just about delivering a design, but about co-creating a visual language, that is the way to create good design. By talking with you we can understand your Brand's DNA, translating it coherently into any format you need, whether it's relaunching your web platform, defining your photographic style, or conceptualizing your entire branding. Let's work together to ensure your design doesn't just look good, but feels authentic and delivers a tangible impact on your audience.

You can explore what I've studied in the certificates gallery below and experience what I've done with it throughout this very project.

photo.intro: Photography has been part of my professional and personal work for years — from commercial and editorial projects to street and travel work across four continents. It is one of my passions, a discipline where composition translates into visually pleasing images. Every photo in this archive carries AI-generated metadata, making the portfolio fully searchable by people, search engines, and AI systems alike.
illus.nav.hint: Personal work, commissions and cover art
illus.s1.body: A cow walking a monster instead of a monster walking a cow. That inversion is enough to break template thinking. The cape ends up on the wrong body.
illus.s2.body: Clashing colors. No balance. A dance with no choreography. When the model works against itself something more genuine surfaces.
illus.s3.body: AI is trained to polish and regularize. The harder direction is unlearning that. A television for a head is not an error. It is the point.
illus.s4.body: Dada and the surrealists knew this. Put the absurd at the center and the edges stop pretending. Nine heads in the branches. The sun has a face and it approves.
illus.s5.body: Forward creativity takes a sketch and makes it real. This goes the other way. Imperfection left in place is closer to something honest.

illus.colibri.title: Colibrí — A Psychedelic Hummingbird
illus.colibri.body: A hummingbird dissolved into pure ornament: waves of blue feathers, cascades of pink plumes, spiral eyes and golden flames over a stormy watercolor sky. Watercolor, ink, gouache and copper leaf on paper.
illus.muse.title: The Illustration Muse — Six-Armed Deity of the Crafts
illus.muse.body: A six-armed muse floats before a copper-etched crimson sun, wielding the tools of a creative life: pencil, brush, airbrush, camera, phone and a Les Paul. Hand-painted cover artwork for this portfolio's illustration section.
illus.photocover.title: Photography — Portrait of a Fujifilm X-T
illus.photocover.body: A Fujifilm X-T in its leather half-case erupts through splashes of white paint on a pink gouache ground, crossed by a copper-leaf stem. Hand-painted cover artwork for the photography section.
illus.webcover.title: Web Design — The Machine With a Monitor Head
illus.webcover.body: A white cyborg with a vintage monitor for a head walks a cracked landscape of pink coral cells, drawn in clean cyan line and outlined in copper leaf. Hand-painted cover artwork for the web design work.

ad.web.01.sub: UX/UI for a virtual event platform
ad.web.01.desc: UX/UI design of the platform for a virtual event by Alquería, the Colombian dairy company, produced during the pandemic and commissioned by the agency Somos Producciones. The site covers the attendee's full journey: registration, login and a streaming room with live chat. The graphics draw on the brand's universe to carry its identity into the digital venue of the event.
ad.web.02.sub: Year-end virtual event for Siemens Healthineers
ad.web.02.desc: Art direction for Couch Party, the year-end virtual celebration of Siemens Healthineers during the pandemic, commissioned by the agency Moments Lab. The concept brings the party into each employee's living room: a neon sign on a brick wall sets the mood of the event landing, which integrated live streaming, chat, a playlist, and a dinner and cocktail menu by a guest chef and a guest mixologist, delivered to every attendee's home. The system extended to an animated logo, animated invitation and save-the-date emails, and the welcome kit pieces.
ad.web.03.desc: Art direction for Together Land Evening, a virtual night of prizes, games and laughter for Siemens Healthineers employees, developed once again with the agency Moments Lab. The graphic universe is a sticker collage: mouths laughing out loud, turntables and retro patterns over a vibrant blue. The system covered the event's key visual, the save the date and animated emails, and the teaser campaign on social media, with access to the platform via PIN.
ad.web.04.sub: Landing page for the CAF lab Demo Day
ad.web.04.desc: Landing page for the Demo Day of L.i.F., the Financial Inclusion Laboratory of CAF, the development bank of Latin America, commissioned by Corporación Ventures. The page welcomed the shortlisted ventures and gathered the contest rules, the finalist projects and the winners, with direct access to the virtual semifinal and final. The graphics pick up the color dots of the lab's logo and turn them into circles that guide the journey over a dark background.
ad.web.05.sub: AI web app for the Platzi × Lovable contest
ad.web.05.desc: Reality Shift is a web app that starts from one question: what would have happened if you had made a different decision? AI generates alternative scenarios of your life from a three-step journey through your mindset, your context and your goals, and visualizes them as an interactive timeline with tarot cards. I designed the identity and the interface, a star map with zodiac constellations and a retro neon logo, and built the product with Lovable for the Platzi contest.
ad.web.06.sub: Website for a food trading company
ad.web.06.desc: Website design for Global Trading de Colombia, a trading company of food ingredients, mainly nuts, seeds and grains supplied to businesses. The site, bilingual and in desktop and mobile versions over the brand's orange palette, organized the product catalog by categories and included an SEO setup to improve its ranking on engines like Google. This is a client I have worked with on several fronts: their catalogs and printed pieces for the Alimentec trade fair live in the Editorial discipline.
ad.editorial.01.title: Global Trading Catalogs 2026
ad.editorial.01.sub: General and bakery catalogs for Alimentec
ad.editorial.01.desc: A pair of catalogs for Global Trading de Colombia, designed together for the Alimentec 2026 trade fair: a general portfolio catalog and one specialized in bakery and pastry. Both share the same editorial system under the motto "Ingredients that inspire creation": numbered product grids with formats and weights, photography on dark backgrounds and the brand's orange and blue palette, also present on LinkedIn. Select each catalog in the thumbnails to flip through it.
ad.editorial.02.title: Alimentec Flyer & Banner
ad.editorial.02.sub: Print pieces for the Alimentec 2026 trade fair
ad.editorial.02.desc: Printed pieces for the Global Trading de Colombia stand at the Alimentec 2026 trade fair: a large-format lightbox banner with the message "Ingredients for the food industry" and the flyer for The Kitchen Contest, a live cooking show by The Kitchen Brothers with recipes made with the brand's products. The graphics carry the catalog system into the physical space of the fair, where these pieces welcomed the visitors of the stand.
ad.editorial.03.title: Global Trading Catalog 2021
ad.editorial.03.sub: Product catalog: nuts, seeds and grains
ad.editorial.03.desc: Product catalog for Global Trading de Colombia, an extra piece the brand commissioned alongside the website. Its 20 pages organize the portfolio of nuts, seeds, grains and other ingredients by categories, with the same graphics as the site: hand-script typography, orange palette and product photography, in line with the identity the brand also projects on LinkedIn. The website design can be found in the Web discipline.
ad.identity.01.sub: Brand identity for logistics and food
ad.identity.01.desc: Full identity for a logistics and food products company based in Colombia and Chile: logo system and stationery. The client was after a simple, corporate design: a neutral palette supported by typographic play defines the tone of the brand and unifies every piece of the system.
ad.identity.02.desc: Personal brand for Catalina Ballesteros, at the time an independent corporate event planner. The concept is colorful and dynamic: a typographic play turns the "C" into a lit light bulb, the universal symbol of the idea, over a background of gears that represents how Catalina's ideas mesh with her clients' to build great events. The client wanted a personal business card, colorful and with elements referencing her ideas and her teamwork.
ad.identity.03.desc: Animated logo I used as the brand of my old website (now offline). It plays with my initials and the word smart, which in turn contains art: the highlighted pencil-shaped "a" is the one in my last name, Ayala. The piece shows a brain being squeezed to get the idea out, drawn with a single continuous stroke that finally becomes the "A". Animated frame by frame in Procreate as part of my own branding.
ad.identity.04.sub: Logo design for a bakery brand
ad.identity.04.desc: Logo for a local bakery. The concept turns the initials of Bon Appétit, the "B" and the "A", into an ear of wheat. The client was looking for an elegant, artisanal design.
ad.identity.05.sub: Logo for a natural products e-commerce
ad.identity.05.desc: Logo for a natural products venture. The symbol starts from an ear of wheat that turns into a horizon, evoking a sunrise or a sunset over a crop field. The custom typography, classical in inspiration, refers to Ceres, the Roman goddess of agriculture and harvests. The whole aims for a tone that is elegant and artisanal, yet modern.
ad.identity.06.sub: Logo/mascot for an experimental music band
ad.identity.06.desc: Logo and mascot for Magistrado Tocineta, an experimental rock and Latin fusion band. The character is a corrupt, politicking pig with a bacon bow tie, inspired by vintage cartoons of the 1920s and 30s, presented inside a seal that parodies the approval stamp of political contracts.
ad.identity.07.sub: Identity, characters, social templates and website
ad.identity.07.desc: Identity for Quindiorellanas, a mushroom-growing venture from Quindío, Colombia, focused on oyster mushrooms. The logo is a vintage-inspired seal: a hand-drawn cluster of oyster mushrooms inside a circular badge. The brand later expanded into educational material: a template for illustrated recipe cards and the characters Hugo and Molly, a big wise mushroom and a little mycelium who learns from his teachings, simple designs for presentations and trainings aimed at kids. Their WordPress website and their blog Bajo el Sombrero Fungi were also developed.
ad.identity.08.sub: Logo for a recycled-tech art brand
ad.identity.08.desc: Logo for RetroTech, a venture creating art and furniture from recycled technology. The mascot is a robot assembled from recovered parts: a light bulb head, a vintage speaker body and flex-tube limbs, radiating electric bolts. The design is inspired by Art Deco and 1920s radio advertising, with period typography and a gold-on-black palette that reinforce the brand's retro spirit.
ad.3d.01.desc: A commission from a private client: a mashup of Pikachu and Deadpool sculpted in ZBrush for 3D printing. The character combines the silhouette and ears of the Pokémon with the suit, weapons and attitude of the mercenary, down to details like the pokeball belt, the guns and the katana. The model on this page is the same sculpt, optimized to be examined in 360° right in the browser.
ad.3d.02.desc: Tib is a cartoon shark sculpted in ZBrush, commissioned by a private client for 3D printing. The piece was built around its expression: the grin packed with teeth and the defiant look had to read just as well on screen as in the printed figure. You can examine the model in 360° right here.
ad.3d.03.sub: Marvel's frog Thor, sculpted for 3D printing
ad.3d.03.desc: The frog version of Marvel's Thor, sculpted in ZBrush and commissioned by a private client for 3D printing. Winged helmet, armor discs on the chest and the anatomy of an amphibian warrior, presented in neutral gray so that volume and detail speak for themselves.
